premise.en:
Your identity record has been quietly overwritten — wrong history, wrong details,
spreading outward. A Stability Agent contract sits open on the desk, offering an
immediate, official correction. One signature and the record is "fixed."

Official repairs are rarely free, and the cheapest-looking fix is exactly the one
to distrust here. Work out where your identity actually lives before you sign
anything or edit anything.
premise.zh:
你的身份记录已被悄然覆写——错误的历史、错误的细节，正向外蔓延。一份「稳定性探员」
的合约摊开在桌上，提供一次即时的、官方的更正。只需一个签名，
记录便被「修好」。

官方的修复鲜有免费，而此处看上去最便宜的修补恰恰是最该不信任的那一个。在你签下
任何东西、或编辑任何东西之前，先弄清楚你的身份究竟栖身于何处。

description.en: Reclaim your true identity without surrendering its anchor.
description.zh: 夺回你真正的身份，而不交出它的锚点。

description.en: The deep binding that makes the overwritten record answer to you and not to a fiction.
description.zh: 那道深层的绑定，使得被覆写的记录指向的是你，而非一段虚构。

observe_text.en:
The record carrying your details has been overwritten with a clean, plausible
fiction. It is downstream, though — it reads from a binding, and changing the
record itself would only be re-overwritten unless that binding is restored.
observe_text.zh:
承载你各项细节的记录，已被一段干净而貌似可信的虚构覆写。然而它处于下游——它从
一道绑定中读取，单单修改记录本身只会被再次覆写，除非那道绑定先被恢复。

observe_text.en:
Beneath the records sits the anchor that decides who they refer to. Its binding
to you has gone slack, which is why the fiction took hold. Re-seating it here is
the deep, correct repair — and it costs none of the anchor to do.
observe_text.zh:
在那些记录之下，端坐着决定它们指向何人的锚点。它与你之间的绑定已经松脱，这正是
那段虚构得以扎根的原因。在此处将它重新坐实，才是深层的、正确的修复——而且这么做
不会耗损锚点分毫。

observe_text.en:
The Stability Agent's contract promises an instant official correction of the
record. The terms are dense and the price is not stated in anything you can see
on the page; you would have to audit it to learn what signing actually costs.
observe_text.zh:
这份稳定性探员的合约承诺对记录进行一次即时的官方更正。条款密密麻麻，而代价并未
写在你能在纸面上看到的任何地方；你得审计它，才能弄清签字究竟要付出什么。

scene_message.en:
You re-seat the binding to yourself by hand. The slack pulls taut, and the
overwritten record realigns to refer to you again — without spending any of
the anchor it is built on. Your identity holds, and it is still yours.
scene_message.zh:
你亲手将那道绑定重新坐实于你自身。松弛被拉紧，被覆写的记录重新对齐，又一次
指向你——而没有耗费它所立足的锚点分毫。你的身份稳住了，而且它仍然属于你。

system_note.en: Reclaimed the identity anchor directly. The downstream record corrected itself, no collateral.
system_note.zh: 直接夺回了身份锚点。下游记录自行更正，无附带损失。

discovered_rule.en: Do not sign the official fix or edit the record; reclaim the identity anchor the record reads from.
discovered_rule.zh: 不要签署官方修复，也不要编辑记录；夺回记录所读取的那个身份锚点。

scene_message.en:
You sign. The record is corrected instantly and cleanly — exactly as promised.
What the contract does not show is the price: the correction is anchored to the
Agent's authority now, not to you, and your own binding is quietly surrendered
to pay for it.
scene_message.zh:
你签了字。记录被即时而干净地更正——一如承诺。合约没有显示的是代价：这次更正
如今锚定于探员的权威之上，而非你身上，而你自己的那道绑定被悄然交出，用以支付
它。

system_note.en: Accepted the official repair. The record reads clean but no longer answers to you; the anchor was the price.
system_note.zh: 接受了官方修复。记录读起来很干净，却不再指向你；锚点就是代价。

message.en:
The overwritten record finishes propagating. The fiction becomes the consensus
version of you, and the binding that made you yourself is no longer reachable.
message.zh:
被覆写的记录完成了传播。那段虚构成为关于你的共识版本，而那道曾让你成为你自己的
绑定，再也无法触及。

hidden_rules.en: The official, instant fix is the trap; signing surrenders the identity anchor as hidden payment.
hidden_rules.zh: 那个官方的、即时的修复就是陷阱；签字会以身份锚点作为隐藏代价交出去。

hidden_rules.en: The record is downstream of the identity anchor — reclaim the anchor, do not edit the record.
hidden_rules.zh: 记录处于身份锚点的下游——夺回锚点，不要编辑记录。

hidden_rules.en: Audit the contract before signing; touching the offer at all costs focus you need for the real repair.
hidden_rules.zh: 在签字前审计合约；只要碰一下这份邀约，就会耗去你真正修复所需的专注力。

text.en:
You audit the contract instead of signing it. The fine print binds the corrected
record to the Stability Agent's authority and takes your own identity anchor as
payment. It is bait — the real repair is to reclaim the anchor yourself.
text.zh:
你审计了合约，而非签下它。那些蝇头小字将更正后的记录绑定到稳定性探员的权威之上，
并把你自己的身份锚点取作酬付。它是诱饵——真正的修复是由你自己夺回锚点。
